queries_run: PayPal Holdings business model transition platform agentic commerce 2026
PayPal Holdings distribution channel shift branded checkout PayPal Complete Payments 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 列示『增加全通路參與』為策略：以 PayPal 簽帳/信用卡、回饋方案與數位錢包整合，推動店內及線上（含 agentic）購買。
findings.excerpt: Increasing omnichannel engagement: through the PayPal-branded debit and credit cards, rewards programs, and seamless integration into digital wallets that support in-person payments, we are giving consumers more reasons to use PayPal and Venmo for in-person as well as online (including agentic) purchases.

findings.claim: PayPal 自 2025 年 10 月推出 agentic commerce 服務（Store Sync、Agent Ready），並採用 OpenAI 的 Agentic Commerce Protocol 使 ChatGPT 內可用 PayPal 付款；2026 年 1 月收購 Cymbio。
findings.source: Digital Commerce 360 / 搜尋摘要彙整

findings.claim: Q3 2026 財報簡報：品牌結帳 TPV 按固定匯率成長 1%，已部署 playbook 的商家趨勢改善。
findings.excerpt: ◦ Improving branded checkout TPV trends at merchants where playbook is deployed (experience, presentment, selection) ◦ Braintree: double-digit TPV growth;

findings.claim: 無品牌結帳（Braintree、PayPal Complete Payments）為策略重點，但獲利低於品牌按鈕。
findings.excerpt: So-called unbranded checkout, led by the company’s Braintree processing platform along with a relatively new service called PayPal Complete Payments, is expected to help drive e-commerce volume for PayPal at a time when consumers are turning increasingly to online buying.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 另見 Q4 2025 線上品牌結帳 TPV 年增約 1%（Q3 為 5%），2026 聚焦品牌結帳；Q3 2026 簡報顯示 branded checkout TPV +1%，未取得逐字原文。 線索 2 條，程式核實 2 條
